detail.command:
set -e
printf '%s\n' '--- XCODE ---'
xcodebuild -version
printf '%s\n' '--- DEVICES ---'
xcrun devicectl list devices || true
printf '%s\n' '--- PROJECT FILES ---'
find . -maxdepth 4 \( -name '*.xcodeproj' -o -name '*.xcworkspace' -o -name 'project.yml' -o -name 'Package.swift' \) -print | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- GENERATORS ---'
command -v xcodegen || true
command -v tuist || true
printf '%s\n' '--- STATUS ---'
git status --short
